parameters.query:
SELECT l.*, t.access_token, i.destino, i.destino_config, i.origen_sf 
FROM meli_leads l 
JOIN meli_tokens t ON l.user_id = t.user_id 
JOIN meli_integraciones i ON l.user_id = i.user_id 
WHERE l.status = 'active' 
AND l.buyer_id IS NOT NULL 
AND l.buyer_id != 0
AND l.buyer_nombre IS NOT NULL
AND l.user_id IN (
  -- BAIC
  310104776,
  3328612086,
  2910875794,
  -- FIAT
  192973256,
  255619619,
  255619706,
  2432747166,
  2569671813,
  1997834029,
  -- PEUGEOT
  296583094,
  296583736,
  296585502,
  188299312,
  3396636159,
  2036674383,
  -- CITROEN
  3318954106,
  3468075382,
  -- DS
  3317595043
)
AND l.bot_uploaded = 0
AND l.received_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)
AND !(l.asesor_phone LIKE '%60236095%' OR l.asesor_phone2 LIKE '%60236095%')
AND !(l.asesor_phone LIKE '%1144356606%' OR l.asesor_phone2 LIKE '%1144356606%')
AND !(l.asesor_phone LIKE '%25910433%' OR l.asesor_phone2 LIKE '%25910433%')
AND !(l.asesor_phone LIKE '%1176234775%' OR l.asesor_phone2 LIKE '%1176234775%')
LIMIT 1000
UPDATE meli_leads SET status = 'skipped' WHERE id = '{{ $('Loop leads').item.json.id }}'
